name: stage2-en-es-agent-utterances
description: English agent-side CS utterances for the en->es reverse-leg benchmark (council decision 2026-06-09). `reference` is the English STT WER target; `expected_translation_es` is informational — eyeball/listen-test the Spanish output quality against it. Texts avoid digits so Whisper's numeral formatting can't inflate WER.

cases.reference: I have blocked your card and a replacement is already on the way.
cases.expected_translation_es: He bloqueado su tarjeta y un reemplazo ya esta en camino.

cases.reference: I can see your current account balance right here on my screen.
cases.expected_translation_es: Puedo ver el saldo actual de su cuenta aqui en mi pantalla.

cases.reference: Your payment was rejected because the card has expired.
cases.expected_translation_es: Su pago fue rechazado porque la tarjeta ha expirado.

cases.reference: Your transfer is still pending and should arrive tomorrow morning.
cases.expected_translation_es: Su transferencia sigue pendiente y deberia llegar manana por la manana.

cases.reference: Your new card will arrive early next week.
cases.expected_translation_es: Su nueva tarjeta llegara a principios de la proxima semana.
